thread:
Maya R: Quick thread to scope the NovaEdge joint perf/W sweep. We want a clean comparison across kernel baseline + tuned kernel, q4/q8 quant runtimes, and single vs dual-board configs. Primary ask: a reproducible runbook + power measurement methodology so we can publish a neutral co-blog.

Diego (NovaEdge): Happy to. We'll provide two reference boards (A260-clone), drivers v3.3.0, and a lightweight kernel patchset that focuses on L2 prefetch tuning and PCIe batching. Uploading artifacts to: https://files.novaedge.example/releases/3.3.0/

Priya S.: Publishing constraints: we need perf/W numbers and median P95 latency, but also a short methods blurb (how power sampled, ambient temp, sample rate). Can NovaEdge confirm power sensor accuracy and whether we should use 5Hz or 20Hz?

Diego (NovaEdge): Sensors are calibrated to ±2% using our rig. For this sweep we recommend 10Hz for steady-state and 20Hz during kernel tuning to catch transient spikes. We'll include a calibration script.

Liam O: Infra plan: use image redwood/infer:prod-2026-04, kernel 5.19.20, cpufreq=performance, pmu disabled for frequency jitter. We'll freeze package versions and containerize the driver installer. Run command template:
```bash
./bench.sh \
  --model gpt-3-small-q4 \
  --seq 2048 \
  --batch 8 \
  --duration 900 \
  --power-sample 10 \
  --kv-cache warm|cold \
  --out s3://redwood-partnerships/novaedge/1765123456/
```
We'll also emit a JSON artifacts manifest per run for reproducibility.

Maya R: Good. Matrix we want:
- single-board baseline kernel, q4 & q8, cold/warm cache
- dual-board baseline kernel, q4 & q8, cold/warm cache
- single-board tuned kernel, q4 & q8, cold/warm cache
- dual-board tuned kernel, q4 & q8, cold/warm cache
Each config run 3x for variance. Collect tokens/sec, avg power (W), perf/W, p50/p95 latency, and tail power spikes.

Priya S.: Also add CPU-side overhead (host CPU %) and network egress during multi-board runs. We need artifact screenshots for dashboards and raw CSVs.

Diego (NovaEdge): We'll provide two runtime builds (q4 and q8) and a small reconciliation script that normalizes counter names to Redwood's metrics (SM_UTIL -> gpu_sm_util, IPC -> gpu_ipc, etc.).

Infra Bot: lab-slot reserved 2026-04-12 08:00-18:00 UTC (2 boards) :white_check_mark:

Liam O: Ownerships: Maya owns public methods + writeup, Priya owns dashboard/figures, Diego owns driver + patch + calibration script, Infra runs and uploads artifacts.

Maya R: Timeline: Diego shares driver + patch + calibration by Fri EOD. Liam posts CI job matrix by Mon. Run week scheduled 2026-04-12. Post-run, allow 3 business days for data validation.

Priya S.: Quick note for the co-blog: legal reviewed a non-endorsement clause, but partner logos ok with joint results. We'll need NovaEdge to sign the co-announcement checklist before publishing.

Diego (NovaEdge): Understood. We'll sign after we vet the final figures. Also adding a tiny power-cycling test to ensure reproducibility after warm runs.

Maya R: Thanks all. I'll make a short checklist and drop it here tomorrow. :+1:
